prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman with fair skin and long layered dark hair with messy bangs sits in the passenger seat of a car at night. She wears black rectangular-frame glasses and has a neutral-to-confident direct gaze. Her outfit is dark red velvet fitted top with lace-trim neckline and cap sleeves, black mini skirt, black patterned fishnet tights with floral lace design, brown leather knee-high boots with multiple heavy metal buckles, and white knit socks peeking from the boots, plus a black choker with silver cross pendant and layered bracelets. Her body angles slightly forward, both hands hold the car's interior grab handle near the roof, and her legs are crossed with one knee raised toward the camera to show boot and textile detail. Use beige leather seats, ceiling handle, seatbelt mechanism, dark windows, harsh direct on-camera flash, bright subject illumination, hard interior shadow, 4:5 vertical framing, deep depth of field, 35mm lens, low luminance noise, and authentic unedited early-2000s digital-camera realism. Keep the pose fashion-editorial and non-sexual.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, malformed car interior, text artifacts
